objects.description: 8-bit alpha channel type. Values range from 0 (fully transparent) to 255 (fully opaque).
Unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB color value in a fixed byte order (A in the top 8 bits, then R, G, B). Used throughout Skia public APIs for specifying colors.
Premultiplied 32-bit ARGB color value. Byte order is configuration dependent to match kBGRA_8888_SkColorType bitmaps. Different from SkColor (which is unpremultiplied and fixed order).
Strongly-typed enum identifying individual color channels (R, G, B, A).
Bitmask flags describing presence of color channels in a format. Provides single-channel bits plus convenience combined masks (RG, RGB, RGBA, GrayAlpha).

functions.name: SkColorSetARGB
functions.signature: static constexpr inline SkColor SkColorSetARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Constructs an unpremultiplied 32-bit ARGB SkColor from 8-bit channel values. Intended for creating SkColor constants or values to pass to Skia APIs.
requirements: a, r, g, b must be in the range [0, 255]; in debug builds SkASSERT will trigger if out of range.
Returns an unpremultiplied ARGB value packed as 0xAARRGGBB.

functions.name: SkColorSetRGB
functions.signature: Macro: SkColor SkColorSetRGB(U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)  // expands to SkColorSetARGB(0xFF, r, g, b)
functions.description: Convenience macro that constructs an opaque (alpha=255) unpremultiplied SkColor from 8-bit RGB values by calling SkColorSetARGB.
requirements: r, g, b should be in [0, 255]; SkColorSetARGB will assert in debug builds if out of range.
Alpha is forced to 255 (fully opaque).

functions.name: SkColorGetA
functions.signature: Macro: uint8_t SkColorGetA(SkColor color)  // expands to (((color) >> 24) & 0xFF)
functions.description: Extracts the 8-bit alpha component from an unpremultiplied SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.
requirements: color must be a 32-bit ARGB value in SkColor packing (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkColorGetR
functions.signature: Macro: uint8_t SkColorGetR(SkColor color)  // expands to (((color) >> 16) & 0xFF)
functions.description: Extracts the 8-bit red component from an unpremultiplied SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.
requirements: color must be a 32-bit ARGB value in SkColor packing (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkColorGetG
functions.signature: Macro: uint8_t SkColorGetG(SkColor color)  // expands to (((color) >>  8) & 0xFF)
functions.description: Extracts the 8-bit green component from an unpremultiplied SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.
requirements: color must be a 32-bit ARGB value in SkColor packing (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkColorGetB
functions.signature: Macro: uint8_t SkColorGetB(SkColor color)  // expands to (((color) >>  0) & 0xFF)
functions.description: Extracts the 8-bit blue component from an unpremultiplied SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.
requirements: color must be a 32-bit ARGB value in SkColor packing (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkColorSetA
functions.signature: [[nodiscard]] static constexpr inline SkColor SkColorSetA(SkColor c, U8CPU a)
functions.description: Returns a copy of the unpremultiplied SkColor c with its alpha component replaced by a.
requirements: a must be in [0, 255]; in debug builds SkASSERT will trigger inside SkColorSetARGB-like usage if out of range.
c must be in SkColor packing (0xAARRGGBB).

functions.name: SkRGBToHSV
functions.signature: SK_API void SkRGBToHSV(U8CPU red, U8CPU green, U8CPU blue, SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts 8-bit RGB components to HSV. Writes hue (degrees in [0,360)), saturation [0,1], and value [0,1] into hsv[0..2].
requirements: red, green, blue are expected in [0, 255].
hsv must point to an array of at least 3 SkScalar elements (non-null).
Alpha is not involved.

functions.name: SkColorToHSV
functions.signature: static inline void SkColorToHSV(SkColor color, SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts an unpremultiplied ARGB SkColor to HSV, ignoring alpha. Delegates to SkRGBToHSV using the color’s R, G, B components.
requirements: hsv must point to an array of at least 3 SkScalar elements (non-null).
color must be a 32-bit SkColor in 0xAARRGGBB packing.

functions.name: SkHSVToColor
functions.signature: SK_API SkColor SkHSVToColor(U8CPU alpha, const SkScalar hsv[3])
functions.description: Converts HSV components to an unpremultiplied ARGB SkColor, passing the provided alpha through unchanged. Out-of-range HSV inputs are pinned.
requirements: alpha should be in [0, 255].
hsv must point to an array of at least 3 SkScalar elements (non-null).
hsv[0] is hue (angle, nominally [0, 360)), hsv[1] saturation [0,1], hsv[2] value [0,1]; out-of-range values are pinned.

functions.name: SkPreMultiplyARGB
functions.signature: SK_API SkPMColor SkPreMultiplyARGB(U8CPU a, U8CPU r, U8CPU g, U8CPU b)
functions.description: Builds a premultiplied SkPMColor from unpremultiplied 8-bit ARGB components, multiplying RGB by alpha and arranging bytes to match kN32/kBGRA_8888 layout.
requirements: a, r, g, b are expected in [0, 255].
Inputs are unpremultiplied; function performs premultiplication internally.

functions.name: SkPreMultiplyColor
functions.signature: SK_API SkPMColor SkPreMultiplyColor(SkColor c)
functions.description: Converts an unpremultiplied SkColor (0xAARRGGBB) to the closest premultiplied SkPMColor, premultiplying RGB by alpha and arranging bytes per native N32 layout.
requirements: c must be an unpremultiplied SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator==
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator==(const SkRGBA4f<kAT>& other) const
functions.description: Component-wise equality comparison between two SkRGBA4f colors.
requirements: No special requirements; compares fR, fG, fB, fA exactly (bitwise equality of floats).

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator!=
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator!=(const SkRGBA4f<kAT>& other) const
functions.description: Logical negation of operator==; returns true if any component differs.
requirements: No special requirements.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator*
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator*(float scale) const
functions.description: Uniformly scales all four components (R,G,B,A) by the scalar factor.
requirements: No special requirements; note that scaling may move components outside [0,1].

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator*
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator*(const SkRGBA4f<kAT>& scale) const
functions.description: Component-wise multiply: returns {fR*scale.fR, fG*scale.fG, fB*scale.fB, fA*scale.fA}.
requirements: No special requirements; note that results may move components outside [0,1].

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::vec
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
const float* SkRGBA4f<kAT>::vec() const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal array of 4 floats in order [R,G,B,A] (const).
requirements: Returned pointer remains valid as long as the SkRGBA4f object remains alive and unmodified in ways that would relocate it.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::vec
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
float* SkRGBA4f<kAT>::vec()
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal array of 4 floats in order [R,G,B,A] (mutable).
requirements: Returned pointer remains valid as long as the SkRGBA4f object remains alive and unmodified in ways that would relocate it.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::array
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
std::array<float, 4> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::array() const
functions.description: Returns a copy of the color components as std::array<float,4> in [R,G,B,A] order.
requirements: No special requirements; returns by value.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator[]
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
float SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator[](int index) const
functions.description: Read-only indexed access to a component: index 0->R, 1->G, 2->B, 3->A. Asserts in debug if index is out of range.
requirements: index must be in [0, 3]; SkASSERT triggers in debug builds otherwise.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::operator[]
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
float& SkRGBA4f<kAT>::operator[](int index)
functions.description: Mutable indexed access to a component: index 0->R, 1->G, 2->B, 3->A. Asserts in debug if index is out of range.
requirements: index must be in [0, 3]; SkASSERT triggers in debug builds otherwise.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::isOpaque
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::isOpaque() const
functions.description: Returns true if alpha equals 1.0f. Asserts in debug if alpha is outside [0,1].
requirements: fA (alpha) is expected to be in [0.0f, 1.0f]; SkASSERT triggers in debug builds if out of range.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::fitsInBytes
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
bool SkRGBA4f<kAT>::fitsInBytes() const
functions.description: Returns true if all channels are in [0,1]. Asserts in debug that alpha is within [0,1] before checking others.
requirements: fA (alpha) is expected to be in [0.0f, 1.0f]; SkASSERT triggers in debug builds if out of range.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::FromColor
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
static SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::FromColor(SkColor color)
functions.description: Creates an SkRGBA4f from an unpremultiplied 0xAARRGGBB SkColor. Only allowed when the SkRGBA4f is unpremultiplied (kUnpremul_SkAlphaType).
requirements: This static function is only allowed/meaningful for kAT == kUnpremul_SkAlphaType (unpremultiplied).
color must be a valid SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::toSkColor
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkColor SkRGBA4f<kAT>::toSkColor() const
functions.description: Converts this SkRGBA4f to the closest unpremultiplied 0xAARRGGBB SkColor. Only allowed when SkRGBA4f is unpremultiplied.
requirements: Only allowed/meaningful for kAT == kUnpremul_SkAlphaType (unpremultiplied).
Channel ranges are not explicitly documented; for meaningful conversion components should represent color channels (typically within [0,1]).

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::FromPMColor
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
static SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::FromPMColor(SkPMColor pm)
functions.description: Creates an SkRGBA4f from a premultiplied SkPMColor. Only allowed when the SkRGBA4f is premultiplied (kPremul_SkAlphaType).
requirements: Only allowed/meaningful for kAT == kPremul_SkAlphaType (premultiplied).
pm must be a valid SkPMColor in native N32 layout.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::premul
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kPremul_SkAlphaType> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::premul() const
functions.description: Returns a premultiplied copy of this color by multiplying RGB by A. Contains a compile-time static_assert enforcing that the source is unpremultiplied.
requirements: kAT must be kUnpremul_SkAlphaType; otherwise compilation fails due to static_assert.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::unpremul
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kUnpremul_SkAlphaType> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::unpremul() const
functions.description: Returns an unpremultiplied copy of this color. If alpha is zero, returns {0,0,0,0}; otherwise divides RGB by A. Contains a compile-time static_assert enforcing that the source is premultiplied.
requirements: kAT must be kPremul_SkAlphaType; otherwise compilation fails due to static_assert.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::toBytes_RGBA
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
uint32_t SkRGBA4f<kAT>::toBytes_RGBA() const
functions.description: Packs the components into 32-bit bytes in RGBA order (e.g., GrColor). Implementation is the same regardless of premultiplied state.
requirements: No special requirements; returns 8 bits per channel packed RGBA.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::FromBytes_RGBA
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
static SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::FromBytes_RGBA(uint32_t color)
functions.description: Constructs an SkRGBA4f from a 32-bit RGBA-ordered packed color value (8 bits per channel).
requirements: color must be a 32-bit value packed as 0xRR_GG_BB_AA in byte order (RGBA).

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::makeOpaque
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::makeOpaque() const
functions.description: Returns a copy with alpha set to 1.0f, leaving RGB unchanged.
requirements: No special requirements.

functions.name: SkRGBA4f::pinAlpha
functions.signature:
template <SkAlphaType kAT>
SkRGBA4f<kAT> SkRGBA4f<kAT>::pinAlpha() const
functions.description: Returns a copy with alpha clamped to the range [0,1]; RGB unchanged.
requirements: No special requirements.

functions.name: SkColor4f::FromColor
functions.signature: template <> SK_API SkColor4f SkColor4f::FromColor(SkColor color)
functions.description: Specialization for unpremultiplied SkColor4f: creates an SkColor4f from an unpremultiplied 0xAARRGGBB SkColor.
requirements: color must be a valid SkColor packed as 0xAARRGGBB.

functions.name: SkColor4f::toSkColor
functions.signature: template <> SK_API SkColor SkColor4f::toSkColor() const
functions.description: Specialization for unpremultiplied SkColor4f: converts to the closest unpremultiplied 0xAARRGGBB SkColor.
requirements: Component ranges for SkColor4f are not explicitly documented here; typical usage is channels within [0,1]. Behavior for out-of-range values is not specified.

functions.name: SkColor4f::toBytes_RGBA
functions.signature: template <> SK_API uint32_t SkColor4f::toBytes_RGBA() const
functions.description: Specialization for SkColor4f: packs components into 32-bit RGBA-ordered bytes (8 bits per channel).
requirements: No special requirements.

functions.name: SkColor4f::FromBytes_RGBA
functions.signature: template <> SK_API SkColor4f SkColor4f::FromBytes_RGBA(uint32_t color)
functions.description: Specialization for SkColor4f: constructs an SkColor4f from a 32-bit RGBA-ordered packed color value (8 bits per channel).
requirements: color must be a 32-bit value packed as RGBA (8 bits per channel).
